# centos 7重置 nameserver

nmcli con mod ens192 ipv4.dns "223.5.5.5 1.2.4.8 8.8.8.8"

[root@localhost wftapp]# nmcli con mod ens192 ipv4.ignore-auto-dns yes

[root@localhost wftapp]# nmcli con down ens192 && nmcli con up ens192

Connection 'ens192' successfully deactivated (D-Bus active path: /org/freedesktop/NetworkManager/ActiveConnection/1)

Connection successfully activated (D-Bus active path: /org/freedesktop/NetworkManager/ActiveConnection/2)

[root@localhost wftapp]# cat /etc/resolv.conf

# Generated by NetworkManager

nameserver 223.5.5.5

nameserver 1.2.4.8

nameserver 8.8.8.8
